input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty or fixed-sum remedy payable by Client, so it sits at the preferred position. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "damages" and "shall pay" return no Client-payable stipulated amounts. Termination (§14) lets Client terminate on written notice with services simply running to the end of the following month — no early-termination fee or minimum-term buyout. The spamming provisions (§7, §8(f)) impose no per-message or fixed penalties; TrueLink merely reserves its legal and equitable rights. Noted but not flagged: §5(a) contains blank minimum monthly fees ("not less than $____ per month") and §6 requires contested amounts to be paid pending resolution; these are ordinary fee-commitment and pay-to-dispute mechanics rather than liquidated damages, though we would want the blanks completed and the minimums confirmed to align with the one-month termination runway.
